strategist_backend_swe.goal_summary: Address the candidate's declared weaknesses in dynamic programming and system design to prepare for Backend SWE interviews at Meta and Stripe within a 10-week timeline.

modules.title: Dynamic Programming Foundations
modules.reason: Dynamic programming is a declared weakness and a standard interview topic critical for backend SWE preparation.
target_outcomes: Recognize DP problem patterns (knapsack, subsequence, grid)
Implement top-down memoization and bottom-up tabulation
Solve medium DP problems within interview time limits

modules.title: System Design Fundamentals
modules.reason: System design is a declared weakness and is essential for backend SWE interviews at target companies.
target_outcomes: Design scalable services using load balancing, caching, and sharding
Reason about consistency, availability, and partition tradeoffs
Produce a structured system design under interview conditions

modules.title: Stripe-style Practical API Design Drills
target_outcomes: Design clean, versioned REST APIs with clear error semantics
Practice practical API design scenarios reflecting Stripe interview emphasis

modules.title: Meta Backend Interview Coding Practice
target_outcomes: Practice timed coding problems in Meta's typical format
Build fluency communicating solutions aloud
